title: Install the AEM Screens player on Mac or PC
summary: Install the Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Screens player on a Mac or Windows PC for local testing of digital signage.
bodyMd:
The Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Screens player can run on a Mac or Windows PC so you can test digital-signage playback locally before deploying to in-store devices.

Before you begin

  • Access to your organisation's AEM instance.

Steps

This procedure is still being written.

Verify it worked

The player runs on the computer and shows content from your AEM instance.
